blurb: Performance Tours Rafting offers whitewater rafting adventures on several Colorado rivers including the Arkansas River, Blue River, and Royal Gorge. Trips range from family-friendly floats to advanced class IV+ rapids. Full day trips include lunch and last about 6 hours total with 4 hours on the river; half day trips last about 4 hours with 2 hours on the river.

quotes.text: Canon City is the location we rafted. Full day. So happy we did. James was our guide. James was absolutely amazing and extremely knowledgeable ! We had lunch. I was impressed with the set up and how well the guides took care of us. There are several tours groups in the area to choose from. We choose this one because it was highly suggested by locals and friends. Im happy we picked Performance Tours.

We did the 1/2 day Royal Gorge trip with Adam and had a blast. We felt safe considering the Class 4 rapids - Adam kept everyone in the boat! He was friendly and experienced. Lodging tip - their Cañon City base is right across the street from a cute vintage campground called Starlight Village. This too was a great place to stay with clean campers for rent.

Our family experience with Performance Tours Rafting was exceptional. Our tour guide, Chris Rice, exceeded all expectations. He was professional, experienced, and entertaining. His knowledge of the river and surrounding environment, as well as his ability to navigate difficult conditions, did not go unnoticed. We will definitely be back!

From the time we arrived at Performance Tours in Canon City to hitting the water—amazing! Our group of nine split into two rafts but stuck together the whole way. First-timers felt safe and confident thanks to our awesome guides. Blaine and Kurt were fun, knowledgeable, and caring. 10/10—we’ll be back and sending all our friends!

Wonderful experience on the Blue River out of Frisco!! This is coming from someone who had tears on the bus ride there and was looking for a way out. It's worth it to all the scaredy cats out there, I promise!

This was our second trip with Performance over the last two years. Full day upper and lower canyon. We had a blast and it was absolutely a beautiful trip, fabulous lunch , and awesome guide Mikey D !!!!!!!!
